_meta.release_note: Trimmed for the Phil realtor kit: generic AI-tell and writing-quality rules only. Personal word bans, the corpus, and the eval harness are not shipped. Advisory only.

suppression.note: An inline token 'writing-lint-disable: <rule-id>' anywhere on or (for line-scoped surfaces) adjacent to the flagged line silences that one rule id for that finding. Bare 'writing-lint-disable: all' silences every rule for the file. The token is recognised in a comment, an HTML comment (<!-- writing-lint-disable: em-dash -->), or a frontmatter 'writing-lint-disable:' list. Phase 2 implements the parser; this convention is fixed here so rule authors can rely on it.

rules.message: Hard-banned AI-tell word. the reader's CLAUDE.md bans these outright. Cut it or say the plain equivalent (this rule's word set is the swap list).
Cluster of canonical LLM-diction words. One is fine; three or more in a passage reads as generated. Rewrite in plain words.
Em dash character. It reads as an AI tell. Use a comma, period, or parentheses instead.
Curly or smart quote. Use a straight quote instead. Matches your terminal and markdown workflow.
Chat-assistant wrapper or opener leaking into the prose. Lead with the outcome, not a greeting or a filler preamble.
Boilerplate closer or recap tag. Delete it: if the paragraph lands its point without the summarizing tag, the closer was padding.

The negation-then-restatement antithesis (reject one thing, then dramatically restate it). Strongest cross-source AI tell. State what the thing is directly. A precise informative contrast stays clean.
Asserts importance without naming a concrete result. A phrase that claims something matters, with no effect or number, says nothing. Name the actual effect.
Vague quantifier or intensifier where a real number exists. Replace it with the number, or cut the intensifier.
Vague appeal to unnamed authority. Name the specific source, or state the measured fact. (An explicit citation in the same sentence keeps it quiet.)
Passive voice that hides who acts on a promised future action. Name the actor: 'the support team will review your request'. A trailing 'by <actor>' exempts it.
Padded circumlocution. Prefer the short plain equivalent (this rule's word set is the swap list).
words: it is important to note that

rules.message: Stacked hedge: the modal already carries the uncertainty, the second hedge is redundant. Keep one ('could affect' or 'possibly affects', not both).
Draft scaffolding left in the prose (placeholder, lorem ipsum, or TBD). Resolve it before this ships.
Unfilled template merge field in prose that never passes through a merge step, so the reader sees the raw braces. Write the real value.
Accidentally repeated word (the repeat often hides across a line break). Delete one.
Long word with a plain synonym. Prefer the short common word.
Absolute adjective paired with a comparator or intensifier. It is non-gradable; drop the modifier.
Exclamation mark. the reader's copywriting rules ban it; the claim should carry the energy, not the punctuation.
Credibility padding or humble-brag lead-in. Lead with the concrete result instead.
Agent-facing heading should use title or short case. Per-genre rule: agent-facing takes title case, doc genres take sentence case.
Doc-genre heading should use sentence case rather than title case. Per-genre rule: doc genres sentence case, agent-facing title case.
